The platform

One workflow from shelf to statement.

Move from what is in stock, to what is selling, to what needs paying or attention. Branch access and audit history keep the work traceable.

01

Inventory

Keep a current view of products, stock levels, counts and branch transfers.

02

Point of sale

Ring up sales, record tenders and reconcile drawers at the end of a shift.

03

Purchasing

Track orders, supplier bills, receipts and the movement of inventory value.

04

Accounting

Post balanced journals, manage periods and review bank reconciliations.

05

People & payroll

Keep employee records, leave decisions and monthly payroll in one place.

At the counter

A sale stays connected to stock and cash.

The POS preview shows a familiar checkout at the front and a clear itemized total beside it. This is sample content; the working app contains the real, permission-controlled flows.

  • ✓ Item quantities and prices stay visible through checkout.
  • ✓ Tender and cash change are shown before completion.
  • ✓ Branch and currency context are kept with the sale.

From draft to audit trail

Payroll review path
1

Prepare

Use effective-dated salary terms, recurring earnings and one-off adjustments.

2

Review

A different authorized user approves the immutable calculation.

3

Post and review

Post to the ledger, export the register or print a confidential payslip.

!
Current scope: This preview is illustrative, not a live calculation. The working payroll page requires approved tenant rules. The 2026 ZWG template includes ZIMRA's sourced daily table for calendar-day proration across hires, departures and salary changes; the USD template leaves daily rules blank pending source verification. NSSA age is checked using confidential HR birth-date data when coverage is confirmed. Mixed-currency salary and journal posting outside the company ledger currency remain future payroll work.
